entries.zh: 起草文书；为呈官（曼达林/老爷）办理文牍
entries.en: to draft documents; to prepare and dispatch papers for the mandarin (Chinese official)

entries.zh: 扑开；扑打开来（拍打使开）
entries.en: to strike open; to knock or break open by blows (headword "desparar" corrupt)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Desparar 及 q. vinen（疑:rinen）疑有讹误，释义依汉字「扑開」与两栏音写（pe-khúi）定为扑打开来。

entries.en: to trim the candle wick; to snuff or trim a candle
to take one's leave; to bid farewell
entries.notes: L 栏音写 Niori（疑:Nioni）疑有讹读但不影响词义；M 栏多出的第二音节 sū 未能系字，按「辞」通行义释义。

entries.en: far, distant; to bid farewell from afar
entries.notes: 西语词头 aMijarn（疑:aMifarn）疑有讹读，官话对音 xiòn 与「远」不合；仅据汉字「远」与闽南音 vân 定义。

entries.en: to forsake and depart far away; to abandon (headword apparently "take leave of one's company", corrupt)
entries.notes: 西语 declarangu（疑读，或为 de la compañía）与官话 xièn 均疑有讹误；依汉字「远棄」与闽南音 vân-khì 释义。

entries.zh: 辞归；辞别归家（临行告辞）
entries.en: to bid farewell at departure; to take leave and return home
entries.notes: 汉字疑号（辞歸/辭歸）仅涉字形变体，四栏语义一致；M 栏 "l." 后系同音重出。

entries.zh: 拜别；行礼告别（弟子拜辞师長）
entries.en: to bid farewell with a bow; disciple's leave-taking of the master
to fan; to send a breeze (Spanish headword partly illegible: "dando alguala…")
entries.notes: 西语 alguala（疑:algula）疑有讹读、词义无法确证；依汉字「送風」与两栏音写释义，西语大意疑为临别相赠之类。

entries.en: to see a guest off; to send away the guest
to resign one's office; to leave one's post
entries.notes: 西语词头后半（ut el juez y acaba）疑有讹误，疑指"如法官任满辞位"之例；汉字疑号仅涉字形，依「辞位」释义。

entries.en: to bid farewell (parting from one another); to take leave
entries.notes: 汉字疑号仅涉字形变体（辞别/辭別），四栏语义一致。

entries.zh: 辞你；向你告辞（"我辞别您"）
entries.en: I take my leave of you; to bid you farewell (Vuestra Merced)

entries.notes: 汉字栏与官话栏均空缺，闽南音写 hun chūy chô 无法系字；西语词头疑有讹误（Desgedeyor/Despedeyor，或为 despedidor「道别者」），无从定夺。

entries.zh: 買辦；采办采买之人（代购物资的办事员）
entries.en: purveyor, provisioner; comprador (one who buys provisions for others)

entries.zh: 糟蹋毁坏；浪费（汉字栏作「打擦」，疑为「打殘」）
entries.notes: 汉字形「擦」与两栏非入声音写（chân/chān）不合，疑字为「殘」；「打殘」与西语 desperdiciador/gastador（浪费糟蹋者）义相合，存两说待校。

entries.en: spring (season); headword "Desperecarse" is not standard 17th-century Spanish (likely corrupt)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Desperecarse 非标准拼写（或为 desperezarse/despertarse 之讹），与「春」对应不明；汉字「春」三栏音写一致（chǔn），中文释义按春季。
M 栏音写含污损（T99）且与官话栏音节数不合、汉字带疑号（疑:榥），无从定夺；仅可参前条疑为 desperezarse（伸懒腰/伸展）一类。
